name: Shafik Quoraishee
role: Senior ML/Games Engineer, The New York Times
bio: Shafik Quoraishee is a senior mobile engineer on The New York Times Games team, leading development for flagship titles like Wordle, Connections, Strands, and the Crossword app. He builds polished, engaging mobile experiences enjoyed by millions of daily players, blending his expertise in AI and software design to support scale and accessibility. Beyond his work at NYT, Shafik is a seasoned speaker in AI and mobile game development—featured at events like Droidcon NYC and the Bletchley Institute’s Technology Summit, where he has presented on topics ranging from game integration to advances in AI and computer vision. His insights have also appeared on podcasts such as the Brave Technologist, where he discussed balancing legacy brand values, viral gameplay, AI-enhanced accessibility, and mobile-first innovation.
